card.fires_on: Fires on a single letter or short piece partway through a name or code, most often the D in CYP2D6 and the vox in fluvoxamine. It also fires inside acronyms and rare proper names.

modes.label: Other names and acronyms
modes.description: A letter inside a party acronym, a species name or a place name.
